title: How GPT‑5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model assists researchers in running quantum computing experiments by automating code generation and experiment setup, leveraging Codex to bridge AI capabilities with complex quantum computing workflows.
problem_solved: Simplifies the complexity of quantum computing experiments by using AI to generate and execute quantum code automatically.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to quantum computing by lowering the technical barrier for researchers to run experiments efficiently.
